statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-27456 is a TOCTOU race in SUID mount(8) loop device setup. Exploitation requires an /etc/fstab entry with user,loop options whose path points to a directory writable by the attacker. DHI Alpine images do not ship such fstab entries and do not invoke mount(8) loop-device setup during normal operation.
